title: Ye Reunites With Kid Cudi for Two Classics at Massive Dallas Concert
summary: According to a press release, more than 83,000 fans attended West's show at AT&T Stadium.
contentText:
Ye (formerly Kanye West ) completed his Texas trifecta with a record-breaking show in Dallas at AT&T Stadium on Saturday night (Nov. 7).

Related

A Timeline of Ye & Kid Cudi’s Relationship

Kid Cudi Responds to Criticism of Ye Support After Chicago Stage Reunion

Ye’s Chicago Homecoming: The 7 Best Moments From Night 2

According to a press release, West drew over 83,000 fans in attendance. After reuniting in September at Ye’s star-studded Chicago homecoming, Kid Cudi popped out to join forces with West once again over the weekend in Dallas.

Cudi sent the audience at Jerry’s World into a frenzy when he joined his mentor atop the spinning globe structure in a red puffer jacket.

The former G.O.O.D. Music running mates performed their The Life of Pablo hit “Father Stretch My Hands, Pt. 1” and then Cudi kept the party going with his “Pursuit of Happiness (Steve Aoki Remix).”

Cudi wasn’t the only special guest to join West, as Dallas native Erykah Badu also made a cameo. The Queen of Neo Soul performed tracks like “Tyrone,” “Didn’t Cha Know,” “On & On” and “Love Of My Life (an Ode to Hip-Hop).”

Ye has performed spot dates across the globe for much of 2026 following the release of his Bully album in March (No. 2 debut on the Billboard 200 ). He has one more stateside show left this year, which will take place on Nov. 21 at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Ariz.

Cudi and Ye reconciled their long-standing friendship earlier this year, which has experienced the highest of highs and extreme lows over the course of the last two decades, but they’re back in a positive place.

The Ohio native supported West at his Yeezy Season 01 fashion show last week in Los Angeles, which also drew appearances from Big Sean, 2 Chainz , Hit-Boy and more.

Monday (Nov. 9) marks the 16th anniversary of Kid Cudi’s Man on the Moon II: The Legend of Mr. Rager album, and Cudi celebrated the seminal project’s birthday in a heartfelt post to Instagram.

“HAPPY 16th ANNIVERSARY OF MAN ON THE MOON 2: THE LEGEND OF MR. RAGER. I almost died making this album,” he wrote to IG. “But I didnt, so yea. This one holds a special place in my heart cuz I didnt know if I’d finish it. You all loved it and continue to remind me just how epic this album was and still is. Thank you for listening and all the love and support all these years. Timeless sh-t, always. Blast this album today and remember the moment you heard it for the first time. Where were you???”

Cudi’s 2010 sophomore album, which features an assist from Ye on “Erase Me,” debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200.
